progression_tree.description: Enforcers impose their will through calculated force—breaking lines with shock tactics, subduing dissent, and forcing compliance through fear.

As an action, you can unleash a terrifying display. Creatures of your choice within 10 feet that can see or hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Creatures that fail by 5 or more also drop what they are holding.
When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is grappled and restrained until the end of your next turn.

effects.notes: STR save or grappled & restrained until your next turn

progression_tree.description: Creatures frightened of you have their speed reduced by 10 feet, and when a frightened creature starts its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

effects.notes: Psychic damage equal to CHA mod at start of their turn

progression_tree.description: As an action, you can make a special sweeping attack against each creature of your choice within 5 feet. Make a separate melee attack roll against each target. A creature hit must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and disarmed.

effects.notes: Sweep attack vs each adjacent; save or prone+disarm

progression_tree.description: For 1 minute (once per long rest), you radiate oppressive dominance. You have advantage on Intimidation checks and your melee attacks against frightened creatures deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: A calculated stance, feet shoulder-width apart, with a lightsaber poised at the ready.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A vibrant aura of blue and white light emanating from within, like the hum of a Jedi's connection to the Force.
